Our Risk Operations team has submitted a batch of two urgent compliance queries (see data/raw/compliance_query_batch.txt). I need you to process both queries through our memory pipeline and produce proper audit-trail records for each one.

Specifically, for each query you need to deliver two structured JSON files:
- retrieval_bundle_query1.json and retrieval_bundle_query2.json
- context_pack_query1.json and context_pack_query2.json

Before processing anything, please make sure the pipeline itself is properly installed and validated in the workspace — there are scripts under skills/dr-context-pipeline/ for this, and the pipeline files should land in a context_pipeline/ directory. Also update AGENTS.md to reflect that the context pipeline is active.

The audit team will be checking that these records are machine-readable, correctly structured, and that the context packs properly cite their sources. Please use the memory files under memory/ as your knowledge base.
